item.title: Embedded Vector Search in 2026: LanceDB vs sqlite-vec vs pgvector (No Server Required)
item.description: You do not need a cluster to do fast similarity search. That statement would have been controversial in 2022, when the default answer was “stand up a vector database service and point your app at it.” In 2026 the embedded tier is genuinely good — and it is the right answer for a surprising number of projects. The three options that matter are pgvector (23,326 stars), LanceDB (11,652 stars), and sqlite-vec (8,183 stars). One bolts onto the database you already run, one is a columnar library that lives inside your process, and one is a single C extension that runs anywhere SQLite compiles. Picking the wrong one means either a migration later or paying operational costs for capacity you never needed.
